name: Muhammad ibn Isma'il al-Bukhari
nameAr: محمد بن إسماعيل بن إبراهيم البخاري

taqrib.ar: جبل الحفظ، وإمام الدنيا في فقه الحديث
taqrib.en: A mountain of memory, and the world's leading authority on the understanding of hadith.

verdicts.en: Devoted the introduction to Fath al-Bari (Hady al-Sari) to defending the book and documenting its narrators, chapter by chapter.

bio: Born in Bukhara, he studied across Khurasan, Iraq, the Hijaz, Syria and Egypt. Author of the collection Sunni scholarship ranks as the most rigorous book after the Qur'an. His conditions for inclusion, which later scholars inferred from the book itself, were stricter than any compiler's before him; he said he drew it from some six hundred thousand reports; Ibn Hajar counts 2,602 connected hadith in it without repetition (2,761 including the suspended reports).
